messages:
acme_ap: Hi @mia — invoice INV-2026-045 is missing our PO. We need the PO on a reissued invoice for our AP process. PO should be 'PO-78451'. We already paid by card (TXN-9c3a) on 2024-12-28. Can you do a reissue or credit/rebill?

mia: Thanks — sorry about that. Can you confirm invoice number and exact PO string? Also did the payment fully clear? Please confirm the payment txn id or last 4 of card.

acme_ap: Confirming: INV-2026-045, PO = PO-78451. Payment TXN-9c3a, card **** 4242, amount 8,341.50 USD on 2024-12-28.

mia: Got it. Looping in @jules from finance to handle reissue/credit. cc @priya for AR. Tagging billing-bot to log a ticket.

billing-bot: Ticket created: BLG-3219 assigned to finance.

jules: We can do credit memo + reissue. Two options: (1) refund the card and issue a new invoice with PO (longer), or (2) create a credit memo for INV-2026-045 and reissue a corrected invoice and apply credit — requires manual reallocation in our AR system. Which does the customer prefer?

acme_ap: Prefer a corrected invoice with PO. If you can issue a credit memo and reissue new invoice and leave the original payment applied, our AP will accept the credit note + new invoice. Need VAT/tax lines to match our EU reverse-charge rules.

priya: For bookkeeping we'll need GL code (4001) and tax code (VAT-EU-REV). Please confirm currency and whether amount changes. Also we need the original invoice PDF for audit.

mia: @acme_ap amount stays the same: 8,341.50 USD. Original invoice showed VAT 0. Can you confirm 'reverse charge' is correct?

acme_ap: Yes — EU reverse-charge applies. VAT should be 0 but display 'Reverse charge — VAT 0%'. PO must appear in Billing reference exactly as 'PO-78451'.

jules: Workflow we'll follow: (a) create credit memo CM-6782 for INV-2026-045, (b) generate reissued invoice INV-2026-045-R with Billing reference = PO-78451 and 'Reverse charge' note, (c) apply CM-6782 to INV-2026-045-R in AR and mark paid. If payment already cleared to our bank, no refund necessary. We'll include memo 'Reissued per customer PO request'.

mia: @acme_ap we'll proceed. Expect reissue within 2 business days. Do you want the PDF emailed to billing@acme.com or uploaded to the portal?

acme_ap: Email PDF to billing@acme.com and cc emma@acme.com. Include original invoice reference in the subject and note the credit memo id.

jules: Noted. @priya I'll perform the credit+reissue workflow and update BLG-3219 with CM/INV attachments. Treasury will not need to refund in this case.

billing-bot: BLG-3219 updated: credit memo created CM-6782; reissued invoice INV-2026-045-R queued for PDF generation.

mia: Thanks @jules. @acme_ap I'll confirm here when the PDF and portal upload are done.

acme_ap: Thanks all :pray:
